title: xeraea sonorae
intro: Xeraea sonorae, commonly known as Desert Lavender, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It is a shrub-like plant native to the deserts of the southwestern United States and northern Mexico, valued for its medicinal and ornamental properties. Xeraea sonorae has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including anxiety and insomnia, due to its sedative and calming effects, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions of promoting relaxation and reducing inflammation. The plant's health benefits are also attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
